phase_detection.startup: Engine running, stationary, RPM still climbing from cold-start idle (rolling RPM slope above the flatten threshold). Ends once RPM stabilizes, not on a fixed timer. Window for cold-cylinder/sticky-valve check: RPM rise should correlate with EGT/CHT rise per cylinder within this window.
phase_detection.warmup: Engine running, no GPS movement, oil warming.
phase_detection.taxi_out: Low RPM, GPS position creeping toward runway/runup area.
phase_detection.runup: RPM ~1600-2100, no GPS movement, mag check.
phase_detection.takeoff: Max power (RPM >= 2400, MP >= 25"), GPS position creeping or airborne, AGL < 200ft.
phase_detection.climb: Airborne (AGL >= 200ft), sustained positive altitude rate (> 350 fpm).
phase_detection.cruise: Airborne, level flight (altitude rate within +-350 fpm).
phase_detection.descent: Airborne, sustained altitude loss (< -350 fpm), not yet near the field.
phase_detection.approach: Airborne, AGL < 300ft near the field, speed < 90kts, speed >= 30kts.
phase_detection.landing: AGL < 300ft near the field, speed < 30kts, decelerating.
phase_detection.taxi_in: Post-landing, low RPM, GPS position creeping.
